settings.title: What lands in your inbox
settings.body: One ZIP. Seventeen numbered modules and a START-HERE that tells you which one to open. Nothing to install, no account with us, no subscription.

settings.title: START-HERE picks your path
settings.body: Sixteen short sections, about six minutes. The one that matters is a table: find your situation on the left, open the file on the right.

settings.title: Set the project context first
settings.body: Module 02 is the step people skip. A CLAUDE.md that states the commands, the boundaries and the definition of done, before a single prompt is run.

settings.title: Run the master prompt
settings.body: Open Claude Code in the project and paste the master prompt for your situation. It runs as staged work, not one wish.
settings.code:
$ claude

> Read 01-Master-System/MASTER-WEBSITE-BUILDER-PROMPT.md
> and work through it stage by stage. Stop at the end of
> each stage and show me what you have.

settings.title: Thirteen stages, in dependency order
settings.body: The workflow is ordered so each stage can be checked before the next one depends on it. Skipping ahead is how a build becomes unverifiable.
settings.code:
Research → Plan → Architect → Design → Build → Write
 → Optimize → Secure → Test → Deploy → Index
 → Monitor → Improve

settings.title: Audits that produce evidence
settings.body: Each specialist module ends in something measurable rather than an opinion — the SEO audit, the security review, the accessibility pass, the launch checklists.

settings.title: And 100 prompts for the rest
settings.body: The library covers the work between the big stages: discovery, planning, development, debugging, performance, content, SEO, security, accessibility, deployment and maintenance.

settings.heading: Before you buy
settings.intro: The questions worth answering before money changes hands.

settings.question: What exactly do I receive?
settings.answer: One ZIP file containing 113 files across 17 modules — over 700 KB of Markdown, more than 110,000 words. Prompts, workflows, templates, and checklists. A manifest inside lists every count, and a SHA-256 checksum is published with the download.

settings.question: Is this an ebook?
settings.answer: No. Nothing here is designed to be read cover to cover. It is meant to be pasted into a terminal while Claude Code is running, then edited to fit the job in front of you. Four documents are written to you rather than to Claude; the rest are working files.

settings.question: Do I need Claude Code?
settings.answer: Yes. This is a system for directing Claude Code, and it does nothing on its own.

settings.question: Is a paid Claude plan required?
settings.answer: Per Anthropic's current documentation, Claude Code requires a Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise, or Console account — the free Claude.ai plan does not include Claude Code access. It can also run against Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, or Microsoft Foundry. Anthropic changes plans and features regularly, so check code.claude.com/docs before relying on this.

settings.question: Do I need to know how to code?
settings.answer: Not professionally. You do need to be comfortable in a terminal and willing to read what Claude produces and push back when it is wrong — the whole system is built around that habit. If you will not review the output, this will not help you.

settings.question: Can experienced developers use it?
settings.answer: Yes, and they tend to get the most out of it. The value for an experienced developer is the structure: gated phases, stated constraints, and completion criteria that stop long unreviewed stretches of generated code.

settings.question: Does it work with an existing website?
settings.answer: Yes. There is a dedicated audit prompt for existing sites, a rescue prompt for broken or compromised ones, and a redesign prompt built around not losing the traffic you already have.

settings.question: Can I use it for client projects?
settings.answer: Yes. The licence covers unlimited projects including paid client work, and you may adapt anything. You may not redistribute, resell, or repackage the files themselves, and it is a single-user licence — each person using the files directly needs their own.

settings.question: Which platforms does it cover?
settings.answer: Dedicated build systems for Shopify, WordPress, Astro, SaaS applications, and landing pages. The master prompt and the security, accessibility, SEO, and checklist material are platform-agnostic. It is not a claim of universal compatibility with every framework.

settings.question: Can it build a SaaS application?
settings.answer: There is a full SaaS module covering tenancy, authorisation, authentication, database migrations, API design, billing webhooks, observability, and a production readiness gate. It will not build a business for you.

settings.question: Are updates included?
settings.answer: Updates within version 1.x, where issued, are made available through your original purchase channel at no extra cost. No update schedule is promised. Version 2.0 and later may be offered separately.

settings.question: How is it delivered?
settings.answer: Digitally, immediately after checkout. Nothing is shipped. You receive a download link for the ZIP file.

settings.question: Is this affiliated with Anthropic?
settings.answer: No. Site Builder Stack is an independent product and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Anthropic. “Claude” and “Claude Code” are product names and trademarks of Anthropic, PBC, referenced here only to describe what this system works with.

settings.question: Will this guarantee rankings, traffic, or revenue?
settings.answer: No, and anyone promising that is selling something that does not exist. This is a professional system for directing Claude Code through planning, development, optimisation, deployment, and launch. Search engines decide what to index and rank; customers decide what to buy.

settings.question: Can I redistribute or resell the files?
settings.answer: No. You may use them on unlimited projects and keep everything you produce, but the files themselves may not be shared, resold, published, or repackaged. Full terms are in LICENSE.md inside the download.

settings.question: What if it is not what I expected?
settings.answer: See the refund policy in the footer. It states plainly how digital purchases are handled, and your statutory rights under consumer law are not affected by it.

settings.body: Crawlability, indexation, structured data, Core Web Vitals, Search Console and content auditing. For a site that exists and is not ranking.
Funnels, page audits, forms, analytics, experimentation and conversion copy. For traffic that already arrives and does not turn into revenue.
Build, rank and convert in one purchase — the three earlier systems on this site, delivered as three downloads.
Monitoring, security checks, backups, dependency updates, deployment gates, incident playbooks and monthly reporting. For the stage after launch, which lasts longest.

settings.heading: Three narrower systems — or the first three together
settings.intro: The Launch System takes a site from nothing to live. These pick up afterwards, and go considerably deeper in their areas than the Launch System does.
